<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useToast } from 'primevue/usetoast'
import { useTickerCurrency, usePercent, gainLossClass } from '@/composables/useFormat'
import api from '@/composables/useApi'
import Button from 'primevue/button'
import Tag from 'primevue/tag'
import AddTransactionModal from '@/components/ui/AddTransactionModal.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const toast = useToast()

const ticker = route.params.ticker.toUpperCase()
const transactions = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)
const showModal = ref(false)

onMounted(fetchLots)

async function fetchLots() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const data = await api.get(`/portfolio/transactions?ticker=${ticker}&limit=500`)
    transactions.value = data.transactions.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date))
  } catch (err) {
    toast.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Failed to load', detail: err.message, life: 3000 })
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

// Compute running weighted average after each transaction
const lots = computed(() => {
  let shares = 0
  let totalCost = 0
  return transactions.value.map((tx) => {
    if (tx.type === 'buy') {
      totalCost += tx.shares * tx.price
      shares += tx.shares
    } else {
      totalCost -= (totalCost / shares) * tx.shares
      shares -= tx.shares
    }
    const avgCost = shares > 0 ? totalCost / shares : 0
    return { ...tx, runningShares: shares, runningAvg: avgCost }
  })
})
